metadata.title: A simple proof of the characterization of $\ell_\infty^n$ by norm-one projections and a stability estimate
metadata.abstract: We give a short and elementary proof of a classical fact that an $n$-dimensional real or complex normed space with the absolute projection constant equal to one is linearly isometric to $\ell_\infty^n$. The proof uses only finite-dimensional convexity and linear algebra, with no infinite-dimensional ingredients. The same approach yields a quantitative stability estimate of order $\varepsilon^{\frac{1}{3}}$ when the absolute projection constant is at most $1+\varepsilon$. This improves Zippin's estimate of order $\varepsilon^{\frac{1}{8}}$ in each fixed dimension as $\varepsilon \to 0$. The real and complex cases are treated by the same arguments.
